label: Car
depicts: Front car outline with two round lights and a curved roof line
use_when: Use when the interface wants a simple front view car with round lights.
avoid_when: Do not use for the smoother grille or sharp headlight cars when the round lights matter.

label: Car
depicts: Front car outline with a wide curved grille line and no visible headlight dots
use_when: Use when the interface wants a softer car front whose main cue is the wide curved grille.
avoid_when: Do not use for the round light or sharp headlight cars when the blank front face matters.

label: Car
depicts: Front car outline with two sharp angled headlight slashes at the sides
use_when: Use when the interface wants the most aggressive car front with sharp side headlight marks.
avoid_when: Do not use for the softer car fronts when the slanted headlight slashes are visible.

label: Bus
depicts: Front bus outline with a wide windshield band and two lower lights
use_when: Use when the interface wants a head on bus with a broad windshield and front lights.
avoid_when: Do not use for the side bus when the flat front transit face is the visible cue.

label: Bus
depicts: Side bus outline with three window panels and two round wheels below
use_when: Use when the interface wants a side view bus instead of a head on front panel.
avoid_when: Do not use for the front bus when the side windows and wheels need to stay visible.
